purpose: Frozen mechanism diagnosis of Experiment 11; not Experiment 12
text_encoding: Historical eager FP32, attention-mask mean pooling, L2 normalization, no truncation, maximum 256 tokens
encoding_backend_revision: Before A2/B/C outcomes or probe fitting, PPU/CPU four-sentence FP32 preflight exceeded the unchanged 2e-6 absolute tolerance (max 2.83355e-6). Use uniform CPU encoding for ALL diagnostic text-cache rows, not mixed CPU/PPU embeddings. Historical A1/C embeddings remain read-only and unchanged. No model/statistical/hyperparameter definition changed.

A1.pairs: all distinct unordered training pairs, not Monte Carlo sampling
A1.covariance_rank: exp(entropy(normalized centered covariance eigenvalues)); also report historical singular-value entropy rank

A2.mean_fc_constraint: clip quantile to +/- subject mean absolute FC; all other statistics and ROI pairs unchanged
A2.small_numeric_rule: prefer +0.001, otherwise -0.001; require unchanged category and valid metric range; record invalid cases without inventing replacements
A2.roi_control: replace first positive pair first ROI by next cyclic 1..116 index unequal to its partner; preserve all edge values and other text
A2.separability: leave-one-patient-out low/high centroid classifier, balanced accuracy; no ASD labels
A2.direction: within-concept pairwise direction cosine and between-concept mean-direction cosine; do not equate nonzero distances with faithful scientific semantics

A3.splitter: KFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=911+fold); never reads ASD labels
A3.targets: all seven raw FC/graph statistics jointly, original physical units
A3.reference: refit caption reference mean and population SD on inner training members; same reference for inner holdout

B.population: only historical outer train; no outer validation/test labels
B.reference: inner training only, regenerated captions and frozen embeddings
B.scaler: separate StandardScaler fitted on inner training for each feature group
B.permutation: label-blind private SHA256 seed; independent bijection in inner train and inner holdout, within outer train; only text rows move
B.capacity_warning: 7 vs 384 dimensions; not capacity-matched and not extra information beyond the original FC

C.image_source: S1 best checkpoint cached single native stochastic forward test_image_embedding [871,16]; zero GTUNet forwards
C.head: strictly restore Linear16->128, GELU exact, Linear128->384; frozen CPU FP32; L2 normalization
C.similarity: float64 dot products after exact FP32 projection/normalization; text normalized again as in historical objective
C.truth: subject IDs only, no diagnostic labels
C.ties: descending score, then global candidate subject index ascending; exact ties counted and reported
C.null_mapping: bijection of candidate identity labels, independently sampled without using scores or ASD labels
C.uncertainty: per-fold 64-null distributions; matched-index mean across ten folds for descriptive aggregate null distribution; not independent cohorts
C.random_baselines: R@k=min(k,N)/N; MRR=H_N/N; expected median rank=(N+1)/2; percentile=50

decision_rules.A: Controlled meanings/numbers are poorly represented and retrieval fails; nonzero embedding differences alone do not establish semantics.
decision_rules.B: Numerical/controlled structure and some ASD probe signal are retained, but paired image/text retrieval lacks consistent useful advantage over fixed random nulls.
decision_rules.C: Patient matching consistently and meaningfully exceeds nulls, yet historical disease benefit is absent.
decision_rules.D: Evidence conflicts or required checks fail; report inconclusive rather than force a positive interpretation.
decision_rules.evidence_policy: Inspect all predefined measures jointly, emphasize test retrieval and null intervals; no post-result hyperparameter changes, no formal independent-cohort significance from overlapping folds
decision_rules.operational_representation_support: At least four of seven mean OOF R2 values positive, all three controlled low/high leave-one-patient-out accuracies above 0.5; no absolute distance threshold
decision_rules.operational_probe_support: Mean B1 AUC above 0.5 and B2, mean B1 CE below B2, B1 AUC above B2 in at least six folds; descriptive only, not clinical significance
decision_rules.operational_matching_support: Both train-to-train and test-to-test mean R1 and MRR exceed their aggregate 64-null 97.5th percentiles; test MRR above its own null median in at least seven folds
decision_rules.operational_weak_matching: Test-to-test and test-to-all871 do not each pass both aggregate R1 and MRR null intervals; no external generalization claim
decision_rules.automatic_decision: C if representation and matching supported; B if representation and probe supported but matching weak; A if representation unsupported and matching weak; otherwise D. Always retain all evidence and caveats.

numerical_checks.repeat_same_batch_required: bitwise equality or explicitly record native backend deviation without relaxing thresholds

prohibited: outer test label based method selection
limitations: historical supervised cross-fold RFE leakage retained in S1
historical eval dropout and VAE sampling
FC-derived text is not an independent clinical modality
small global descriptors and ROI numbers are not verified anatomical language
